material.title: Acme reports data-center revenue growth and raises capacity spending guidance
material.sourceName: Acme Investor Relations（虚构格式示例）
material.bodyOriginal: Fictional example for annotation format only. Acme reported quarterly data-center revenue of $2 billion, up 40% year on year, and a 55% gross margin. It raised full-year capital expenditure guidance from $500 million to $700 million to expand advanced packaging capacity. These are disclosed results and guidance, not a stock-price forecast.
